snippet.title: SOE64 Gameplay Trailer - "Goldeneye style FPS set in WW2"
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4546760/SOE_64/
S.O.E 64 is a 90s inspired WW2 shooter in development at HatchettStudio

"Goldeneye set during WW2" - We aim to capture the feel of the classic 90s console shooters whilst upgrading general quality of life and now outdated design principles, all in a gritty new wrapper of the European theatre of war.
